_comment: council-engine-spec.md §4.1. Rubrics are per artifact kind and are DECLARED, not inferred. A skill may override the default rubric for its kind. Weights are equal until accuracy data says otherwise (FR-SCORE-004).

criteria.label: Clarity
criteria.guidance: Can a reader who was not in the room act on this?

criteria.label: Completeness
criteria.guidance: Is every template section present and substantive?

criteria.label: Accuracy
criteria.guidance: Is every claim supported by a cited input?

criteria.label: Relevance
criteria.guidance: Does it answer the question asked, without padding?

criteria.label: Quality
criteria.guidance: Would you put your name on it?

criteria.label: Feasibility
criteria.guidance: Will these steps execute against the real repository?

criteria.label: Completeness
criteria.guidance: Does the plan cover tests, errors and callers?

criteria.label: Sequencing
criteria.guidance: Is every step unblocked by the one before it?

criteria.label: Risk Management
criteria.guidance: Is the blast radius named and contained?

criteria.label: Clarity
criteria.guidance: Could another engineer execute this unaided?

criteria.label: Accuracy
criteria.guidance: Is each finding real and correctly located?

criteria.label: Actionability
criteria.guidance: Does each finding name a next action?

criteria.label: Clarity
criteria.guidance: Is it readable by someone who did not write the change?

qualityThreshold._note: DEC-27: the AI quality score is advisory with a recorded override. It is NEVER accuracy. Human G4 scoring remains mandatory.

autoFailRules.label: At least one cited source per scorable section
